1.explanation: All of the blocks-workspace UI is composed in components/blocks/blocks.jsx — this is where the Blockly instance, zoom buttons and workspace container live, so the watermark overlay and styling must be added here.  The data for which image to draw and how to fetch its thumbnail (sprite vs. backdrops, current costume index, VM asset URLs, RTL direction flag, etc.) flows in through the Redux connector in containers/blocks.jsx.  You’ll need to pull the selected target’s thumbnail URL in the container and pass it into the Blocks component, then render and position it in blocks.jsx next to the zoom controls with the correct size, opacity and RTL support.
1.bug_scenario: When a user is editing code in the blocks workspace the faint “ghost” of the currently selected sprite or backdrop (_the watermark_) is missing.  In earlier versions Scratch showed a 35%-opacity, right-aligned, 48×48px thumbnail of the active costume behind the blocks UI (just above the zoom controls).  In today’s GUI the workspace renders blank, so it’s unclear which target is being edited.  The mocks show the little dino, bear or stage thumbnail in the top-right of the blocks pane, aligned to the zoom buttons, sizing at max 48×48px, obeying RTL, opacity and z-index specs.

2.explanation: • src/components/blocks/blocks.jsx: This component renders the Blockly workspace and its surrounding UI (including the zoom controls). It’s the natural place to insert the watermark element, sized and positioned relative to the zoom buttons. • src/containers/blocks.jsx: This container wires the VM’s selectedTarget and its current costume/backdrop thumbnail URL into the blocks pane. It needs to pass the asset URL and active state down so that the watermark updates when you pick a new sprite or switch to the stage. • src/components/controls/controls.jsx: Hosts the +/– zoom controls. We must ensure the watermark is right-aligned to this controls container (and flipped in RTL), so its CSS or wrapper markup here will need an RTL tag or a relative positioning context. • src/lib/layout-constants.js: Defines workspace margins, padding, and control offsets. We need a new constant for the watermark’s 20px top margin and max 48px size, so it stays aligned to the pre-existing zoom control offsets. • src/css/blocks.css: The stylesheet that governs the Blocks pane. We’ll add rules for the watermark class (.workspace-watermark) to set its max-height/width (3rem), 35% opacity, z-index (below the blocks), and RTL-aware right/left positioning.
2.bug_scenario: When you select a sprite or backdrop in the Scratch 3.0 editor, there used to be a faint, oversized “watermark” of the selected asset behind the blocks workspace (max 48×48px, 35% opacity, right-aligned to the zoom controls). That watermark is completely missing in the current build—the top-right corner of the blocks pane is blank, and when you swap between sprites or switch to the stage, there is never any translucent preview image shown. This makes it harder to know at a glance which target you’re editing.
